description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ProviderStartException' used within the Orleans streaming provider framework. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios and is marked as serializable. The class extends OrleansException and is part of the Orleans.Streams namespace.

classes.name: ProviderStartException
classes.description: A specialized exception thrown when a streaming provider fails to start, extending OrleansException and supporting serialization.

methods.name: ProviderStartException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor with an error message and inner exception.
